title: CPMigrate Baseline
description: Analyzer findings a team has accepted. Runs given --baseline still report these findings but do not fail on them, so a repository with existing debt can gate CI on new problems only. Generate with: cpmigrate --analyze --write-baseline

$schema.description: JSON schema reference for IDE autocomplete

fingerprintVersion.description: Scheme the fingerprints were computed with. A baseline written under a different scheme is rejected rather than silently matching nothing.

createdWith.description: CPMigrate version that wrote the file

findings.description: The accepted findings. Human-readable fields accompany each fingerprint so the file can be reviewed in a pull request.

fingerprint.description: Stable identity of the finding: rule, package, and affected projects. Deliberately independent of the observed versions, so version drift does not unsuppress accepted debt. Note: projects are identified by file name, so two distinct projects sharing a basename currently share an identity.

issueCode.description: Rule that produced the finding — see docs/rules.md

severity.description: Severity when the baseline was recorded. Informational only: the gate uses the severity observed on each run.
